lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Files_FullTextSearch_Mail\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
2 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

places: lib/Service/MiscService.php:69 OCP\ILogger::log(): deprecated since Nextcloud 20, Nextcloud 30 is the last major to have it; use \Psr\Log\LoggerInterface::log
lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated and that Nextcloud 36 no longer has: the app fails on the first major without it, once it declares that one.
